mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals active monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal housing sector contraction, reducing consumer wealth and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 105.0 indicates robust manufacturing expansion, driving corporate earnings growth and supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 105.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Real personal consumption (RSAFS) below 470,000 million dollars signals weakening consumer demand, causing immediate negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS falls below 470000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate below 4.0% indicates a tight labor market, triggering wage inflation and subsequent Fed rate hikes that produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above its 12-month moving average signals sustained manufacturing strength, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 12-month MA, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer price index above 245.0 indicates accelerating inflation, prompting Fed tightening that reduces equity valuations and generates negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 245.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3 years.
